question: Should these four live human-hold/no-fix OpenClaw candidates be allowed into fix-enabled autonomous jobs, or should this drip be regenerated/downgraded before merge?
rationale: The PR intentionally adds autonomous job files, but the live candidate labels indicate maintainer/product/repro/no-fix handling and current deterministic gates do not block those issue labels from fix-enabled job output.

options.title: Regenerate or downgrade before merge
options.body: Exclude the human-hold/no-fix candidates from this autonomous drip or make the jobs non-fix-enabled until the live labels clear.

options.title: Add explicit calibration
options.body: Keep the jobs fix-enabled only if maintainers add job-level calibration explaining why these specific label holds are intentionally overridden.

options.title: Accept the automation risk
options.body: Merge as-is and rely on the worker prompt to choose needs_human despite the permissive fix-enabled frontmatter.

recommendation.title: Regenerate or downgrade before merge
recommendation.body: Exclude the human-hold/no-fix candidates from this autonomous drip or make the jobs non-fix-enabled until the live labels clear.
